forecasts.question: Will a TIER1-confirmed Israeli airstrike in Lebanon killing at least 5 named/reported persons occur in any 48-hour window between 2026-08-24 and 2026-08-27?
forecasts.delta_reason: New NEAR-TERM forecast. Israeli warplanes struck Nabatieh, Kfar Rumman, and the Ali al-Taher Heights overnight 2026-08-21 per Times of Israel and Middle East Monitor; France 24 reported 11 killed in southern Lebanon strikes on 2026-08-15. Judge sets p=0.60 (below Analyst's 0.65) because the recent cluster events (Aug 15) occurred nine days ago and no ≥5-fatality single 48h cluster has been TIER1-confirmed inside a rolling window since Aug 15-16; base rate accounts for near-daily activity but not automatic multi-fatality clusters.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Reuters, AP, AFP, Al Jazeera, or Times of Israel report by 2026-08-27T23:59Z a single Israeli airstrike (or coordinated strike series in one rolling 48h window) in Lebanese territory with confirmed at least 5 fatalities citing Lebanese Ministry of Health, Lebanese Armed Forces, or UNIFIL.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Requires at least one TIER1 wire (Reuters/AP/AFP) AND at least one regional TIER1 (Al Jazeera/Times of Israel/L'Orient Today). Iranian or Hezbollah figures alone insufficient.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If casualty figures are disputed between IDF and Lebanese sources by more than 50 percent, use lower confirmed count. If deaths only appear in Hezbollah/AMAL statements without TIER1 confirmation, treat as NOT-OBSERVED. Israeli artillery-only shelling (no airstrike) does not qualify.

forecasts.question: Will Iran and Oman publicly confirm a formal bilateral Hormuz transit-route agreement (signed or joint statement by both foreign ministries) by 2026-09-15?

Iranian FM spokesman Baghaei stated 2026-08-10 that an understanding on the transit route map had been reached; Majlis Committee approved Article 3 of the Strategic Action Plan for Security and Development of the Strait of Hormuz on 2026-08-23 (IRNA, Mehr News, TRT World, Al Jazeera live blog). Guardian Council review pending and Omani MFA has not publicly confirmed. Trump remarks against Muscat and Bessent D-Day rhetoric operate as headwinds. Judge sets p=0.35 (below Analyst's 0.45) because bilateral text requires Omani sign-off that Muscat has not publicly telegraphed and 22 days is tight for Guardian Council + Omani MFA choreography.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Iran MFA (statement, IRNA, or Press TV) AND Oman MFA (Oman News Agency or MFA release) both publicly confirm to Reuters, AP, AFP, or Bloomberg a bilateral text or joint statement specifying transit corridors and effective date, by 2026-09-15T23:59Z. Committee-only or parliament-only actions do NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Requires bilateral confirmation: Iran side (MFA statement, IRNA, or Press TV) AND Oman side (Oman News Agency or MFA release) plus at least one TIER1 wire (Reuters/AP/AFP/Bloomberg).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If Iran unilaterally announces without Omani confirmation, resolve NO. If a preliminary understanding or memorandum is signed but text is unreleased, resolve AMBIGUOUS-YES only if both sides publicly attest to binding effect. If Oman confirms but Iran defers pending Guardian Council, resolve AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

Partial re-openings (permitted-country tankers only, e.g. Iraqi or Chinese carve-outs) count toward the total. Naval-escorted commercial convoys count; military vessels do not.
